records.identity_access_and_cruising_history: Mariborski otok is natural island in Drava River near Kamnica, protected nature monument with managed public swimming complex and woods. Primary source's older text alleges summer gay cruising on/near wooded riverbank; 21 March 2026 spot-specific user reports path to beach devastated and many men shifting to Betnava. This is a dated firsthand/knowledge-of-change claim, not a confirmed physical encounter at the original location. Official Maribor operator says island now reopened for walkers after September 2026 summer season but asks visitors to avoid swimming-pool deck during cleanup. Distinct near-power-plant source spot 0.5km away, potential separate subarea.

independent_and_related_sources.notes: River island natural monument, public bathing complex and recreation
Island reopened to walkers but pool deck restricted during cleanup
June 2026 seasonal hours and renovations; public complex, not permission for sex
Separate source record 0.5km away, do not merge without coordinates
